specs.Item Type Name: Dubstep Bassline Mix Wireless Speaker with Wireless Karaoke Mic

features: Powerful Sound - 14W Powerful Sound with 57mm Driver – Enjoy rich, room-filling audio with a 14W speaker and 57mm dynamic driver delivering deep bass, clear vocals, and balanced sound for music, movies, karaoke, and everyday entertainment.

Wireless Karaoke Microphone- Wireless Karaoke Mic with Voice Effects – Includes a wireless microphone featuring Male, Female, Kid, Magic, Studio, and Karaoke voice modes, making it perfect for parties, birthdays, family gatherings, and fun singing sessions.

Long Battery Life - Up to 8 Hours Playtime & Type-C Fast Charging – Keep the entertainment going with up to 8 hours of playback on a single charge and convenient USB Type-C fast charging for quick power-ups.

Bluetooth & Multiple Playback Modes - Bluetooth 5.3 & Multi-Mode Connectivity – Stream wirelessly with Bluetooth v5.3 or play music via USB drive, TF card, AUX input, and Wireless Karaoke mode for flexible listening anytime, anywhere.

Premium Design & RGB Lights- Portable Premium Design with RGB Lights – Features a stylish leather finish, metallic accents, RGB light bar, integrated carry handle, and easy onboard controls for effortless portability and an enhanced party experience.
description: Feel The Bass Drop. Own The Stage. Turn every moment into a performance with the Dubstep Baseline Mix, the portable wireless karaoke speaker that combines powerful audio, premium design, and endless entertainment. Whether you're hosting a house party, enjoying family karaoke nights, travelling with friends, or simply relaxing at home, Dubstep Baseline Mix Wireless Speaker delivers an immersive sound experience with a premium look. Powered by a 14W audio system featuring a 57mm dynamic driver, Dubstep Baseline Mix Wireless Speaker produces rich bass, clear vocals, and balanced sound that fills your room. Designed with Dubstep's signature premium leather finish, metallic accents, and an integrated carry handle, it looks as good as it sounds. Take your performances to the next level with the included wireless karaoke microphone featuring multiple voice effects including Male, Female, Kid, Magic, Studio, and Karaoke modes. Easily control playback, volume, and microphone settings directly from the mic, making every performance effortless and interactive.
